t: Ultragrime Pro Multiuse Plastic-Free Cleaning Wipes supplied in a single pack of 100 heavy-duty wipes for trade environments. These large, thick cloth wipes remove stubborn dirt, oil, grease, paint and silicone from surfaces. Ideal for plumbers, mechanics, and builders working on busy construction sites, the strong fabric remains wet for over 1 hour when out of the packet. Dermatologically tested with aloe vera, the organic solvent formula is safe on skin while cleaning tools, equipment and walls.
